name: sim_rustworkx_capability
purpose: Tool-capability isolation probe for rustworkx -- unblocks its load-bearing use in ~25 sims.

pytorch.reason: no automatic differentiation or tensor computation required in this probe

pyg.reason: no graph learning required; probe operates on density matrices not graph structures

z3.reason: no SMT constraint solving or UNSAT proof required in this probe

cvc5.reason: z3 sufficient for all separability and product-form UNSAT proofs in this sim

sympy.reason: no symbolic computation or algebraic proof required in this probe

clifford.reason: no Clifford rotor or geometric algebra computation required in this probe

geomstats.reason: no Riemannian manifold computation required; geometry handled analytically

e3nn.reason: no SO(3)-equivariant neural network computation required in this probe

rustworkx.reason: capability under test -- DAG / toposort / transitive reduction / Dijkstra / cycle detection

toponetx.reason: no chain complex or cell complex computation required in this probe

gudhi.reason: no persistent homology or Rips complex computation required in this probe

toposort_diamond.detail: every edge (u,v) must have pos(u) < pos(v)

toposort_vs_networkx.detail: both orderings must be topologically valid (not necessarily identical)

dijkstra_01_3.detail: shortest path 0->1->3 has length 2; 0->3 direct is 4

acyclic_detection_positive.detail: diamond DAG must register as acyclic

witness_shell_nesting_dag.detail: Replays the shell-nesting DAG operations (PyDiGraph, topological_sort, dag_longest_path_length, is_directed_acyclic_graph) used load-bearingly in the witness sim.

toposort_on_cycle_raises.detail: rustworkx must refuse to linearize a cycle

ill_formed_edge_raises.detail: edge to undefined node must raise

empty_graph_acyclic.detail: empty graph is vacuously acyclic with empty topo order

perf_vs_networkx_1k.detail: Both orderings must be valid; speedup reported for context, not load-bearing.
